<entry id="B01143">
<head-word>בַּקְרָא</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> c. (בקר) 
<italic>herd</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. Deut. VII, 13 בַּקְרַת תוריך (h. text שגר אלפיך). B. Mets. 84
<sup>a</sup> ב' דתורי a herd 
<pgbrk id="pg188" />of oxen, (Var. פדנא, v. Rashia. l. a. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2).—
<plural-form>Pl. m. בַּקְרִין,</plural-form> constr. בַּקְרֵי. Targ. O. Deut. l. c.; Targ. ib. XXVIII, 4.—Fem. בַּקְרָן. Targ. Joel I, 18; Is. VII, 25.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01144">
<head-word>בַּקְרוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (בָּקָר) 
<italic>cattle-yard, cattle-farm, stock of cattle</italic>.</definition>
<notes> M. Kat. 12
<sup>a</sup>; Tosef. ib. II, 11 ביקורת (Var. בקירות, בקרות); Y. Pes. IV, 31
<sup>b</sup> top בקורת. Y. Yeb. IV, 6
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. Nidd. I, 49
<sup>b</sup> top; Gen. R. s. 20 [read:] בקרות של בית אנטונינוס היתה עֹובֶרֶת והרביעו (שוורים) ממנה בַקְרוּת של בית רבי the herd of the estate of A. passed by and (some oxen) thereof covered the herd of Rabbi’s estate; [perhaps the second בקרות is to be read בְּקָרוֹת fem. pl. of בִּקְרָה; v. Var. lect. in l. c.]</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<italic>Pi.</italic> בִּיקֵּשׁ, בִּקֵּשׁ 
<italic>to seek, desire, beg, ask</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 65
<sup>a</sup> מְבַקְּשִׁין וכ' the court begs him to give her a letter of divorce, opp. to כופין. Ber. 12
<sup>b</sup> בִּקְּשׁוּ לקבוע וכ' they (the Rabbis) intended to insert the chapter about Balak &c. Gen. R. s. 84 ב' לישב וכ' he intended to live in peace; a. fr.—ב' רחמים 
<italic>to pray</italic> (for mercy), v. בעי. Ber. l. c. B. Bath. 91
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְבַּקֵּשׁ, </binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Nithpa</italic>.</definition>
<notes> נִתְבַּקֵּשׁ 
<italic>to be sought, to be hunted for</italic> (by detectives); 
<italic>to be summoned</italic>. Taan. 29

<entry id="B01149">
<head-word>בַּקָּשָׁה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> preced.) 
<italic>desire, prayer</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ned. XI, 12 דרך ב' in the way of a request (to give a divorce, v. preced.). Ber. 9
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. אין נא אלא לשון ב' the word נָא in the Bible means prayer (I pray &c.). Ib. 57
<sup>a</sup> תלויה בַקָּשָׁתֹו his prayer is held in suspense (its fulfillment is doubtful).—בב' ממך 
<italic>I pray thee</italic>, v. בָּעוּ. Ib. 9
<sup>a</sup>. Gen. R. s. 75 end; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. בַּקָּשֹׁות</plural-form></notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01150">
<head-word>בִּקְתָא, </head-word>
<head-word>בִּיקְתָא</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (= בקעתא, v. 
<xref rid="B00009">בָּאגָא</xref> a. 
<xref rid="A00083">בִּקְעָה)</xref>
<italic>valley, short cut; group of fields</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 34
<sup>b</sup> bot. I consider him arrogant מאן דמצלי בב' (Ms. M. a. Ar. בפִקְתָא q. v.) who prays in a valley (where people pass by). Keth. 54
<sup>a</sup>; 103
<sup>a</sup> בביתי ולא בביקתי ‘in my house’ (‘as long as you will spend your widowhood in my house’—the marriage contract reads) but not in my estate, i.e. she must be content to live in her late husband’s house with his heirs, but she cannot claim a separate residence. [Comment. בקתי = בי עקתי house of my distress, narrow house, i.e. when there is no room for her and the heirs, she loses her claims, v. Sabb. 77
<sup>b</sup>, etymol. of ב' = בי עקתא narrow place.]—בר בי' (בת) one of the same rural community; trnsf. 
<italic>of the same class</italic> or 
<italic>category</italic>;
<italic> neighbor</italic>. Men. 24
<sup>b</sup> כולהו בני ב' they all belong together. Meïl. 17
<sup>b</sup> בני חדא ב' of the same category.—Yeb. 84
<sup>a</sup> בת בי' (ed. בּוּקְתָא) a parallel case stated immediately after.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01152">
<head-word>בַּר, </head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> ברר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>empty, open</italic>] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>uncultivated ground, forest, prairie;</italic> opp. יישוב.</definition>
<notes> Kil. VIII, 6. Ḥull. 80
<sup>a</sup> שור הבר the ox of the prairie, 
<italic>buffalo</italic>. Ib. איל הב' forest ram. Y. Sabb. XIV, 14
<sup>b</sup> bot. חזיר של ב' wild swine.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>clear, visible</italic>, whence 
<italic>the outside, surface</italic>, opp. תוך.</definition>
<notes> Yoma 72
<sup>b</sup> a scholar שאין תוכו כבָרֹו whose inside is not as his outside (who is insincere); Ber. 28
<sup>a</sup>. Y. Pes. VII, 34
<sup>a</sup> bot. תוך בר the inner parts of the Passover lamb must hang outside (not be put inside, v. R. Akiba in Mish. VII, 1); Mekh. Bo, 6 תוך ובר (read תוכו בר); Pes. 74
<sup>a</sup> R. Ish. called it תוך בר Ar. s. v. תך 2 (ed. תוך תוך, Var. in Rashi a. Ar. תוכברא q. v.).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01153">
<head-word>בַּר, </head-word>
<head-word>בָּר, </head-word>
<head-word>בָּרָא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition> (= h. שָׂדֶה, יַעַר) 
<italic>forest, prairie</italic> &c. Targ. Ps. L, 10 sq.</definition>
<notes> &c. Targ. Ps. L, 10 sq. Targ O. Gen. III, 1; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (adj.) 
<italic>living in the forest</italic> &c., 
<italic>wild</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. l. c. Var. תרנגול ברא; Sabb. 78
<sup>a</sup> תרנגולא ב' Ms. M. (ed. … לת) woodcock (hen of the prairie).—</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>*3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>peel</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 139
<sup>b</sup> ב' דתומא the peel of garlic; [Rashi, expl. צלע, must have read אברא].</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (= h. חוּץ) 
<italic>outside, outdoors, street</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. XXXIV, 31 נפקת ב' a prostitute, v. חוּץ II; a. fr.—Y. Kil. IX, 32
<sup>b</sup> מאן בעי לך לבר who wants thee outside? (an intimation to leave the room). Snh. 62
<sup>ab</sup>; Sabb. 106
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. פוק תני לברא go out and teach it in the street (i.e. your tradition is rejected).—תנא ברא a Tannai not recorded in the Mishnah, v. בָּרַיְיתָא. M. Kat. 17
<sup>b</sup> (Rashi: האי תנא דברייתא); B. Bath. 93
<sup>b</sup> Ar. (ed. בתרא); cmp. בָּרָאָה.—4) (prep. a. adv.) 
<italic>outside;</italic> בר מן 
<italic>outside of, except, without</italic>. Targ. O. Gen. XIV, 24; a. fr.—Ber. 38
<sup>b</sup> ב' מן דין וב' וכ' without this and without that, i.e. apart from these two arguments. Y. Erub. VII, end 24
<sup>d</sup> ב' מדעתיה without his knowledge; a. fr.—Ḥull. 62
<sup>b</sup> וסימניך ב̇ר̇ מיניה and thy mnemonical sign (as to צרדא a. ב̇ר̇דא, the one being forbidden, the other permitted) be: keep aloof from it (ב̇ר̇דא).—Trnsf. 
<italic>restriction</italic> (everywhere except …), 
<italic>proviso</italic>. Succ. 45
<sup>b</sup>; Snh. 97
<sup>b</sup> who enter the heavenly courts בב' with certain qualifications (by special grant), בלא ב' without any restrictions.—לְבַר, מִלְּבַר 
<italic>apart from, outside, exclusively</italic>. Cant. R. to VII, 8 לב' מישראל except the Israelites. Ḥull. 98
<sup>a</sup> sixty one, בהדי דידה או … לב' מינה the one (egg) included or excluded? B. Bath. 90
<sup>b</sup> שתותא מלב' the sixth part (as an addition) is outside, i.e. to each five portions one is added, an addition of twenty percent, opp. מִלְגֵו. B. Mets. 53
<sup>b</sup>, v. חוּמְשָׁא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01154">
<head-word>בַּר, </head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<head-word>בְּרָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>(b. h. בַּר poetic; ברי) 
<italic>son, offspring</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. IV, 25; a. v. fr.—ב' שמואל son of Sam.; … בְּרֵיה דר' son of … Ber. 3
<sup>a</sup>. Ḥull. 11
<sup>a</sup>; a. v. fr.—B. Mets. 110
<sup>a</sup> … בְּרָהּ דבת the son of the daughter of … Sabb. 116
<sup>b</sup> במקום ברא ברתא וכ' where there is a son, the daughter cannot inherit. Y. Shebi. IX, 39
<sup>a</sup> bot. אמה דהן ילדת ב' this nan’s mother has born a son, i.e. she may be proud of him; Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 43
<sup>d</sup> אית לאימיה ב' (not ואית); a. v. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. [בְּרִין, בְּרֵי</plural-form>. Targ. Y. Ex. X, 9 (some ed.). Targ. Ps. CXXVII, 5 Ms.] בְּנִין, בְּנֵי, בְּנַיָּא. 
<pgbrk id="pg189" />Targ. Gen. V, 4 בְּנִין וּבְנָן sons and daughters; a. fr.—Keth. IV, 10 (in a marriage contract) בנין דכרין male issue, opp. בְּנָן נוקבין, ib. 11.—Ber. 10
<sup>a</sup> ב' דמעלו good children. Y. B. Bath. VIII, 16
<sup>b</sup> bot. אין הוון בנוי דהנייה (read בָּנַיי) if my children turn out well; a. v. fr.—בר בר, בר בת 
<italic>grandson</italic>. Esth. R. introd. (expl. נין ונכד) בר ובר בר (not וברבר) son and grandson; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Fem.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בְּרַת</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>.</definition>
<notes> [The meaning of בר in compounds is generally the same as of בן a. בעל, e.g. ב' אולפן 
<italic>a scholar</italic>, ב' אמודאי 
<italic>a diver</italic>, ב' שטיא 
<italic>a maniac</italic>, ב' דעת 
<italic>a rational being</italic>. בר בי רב, v. בֵּי. For compounds which are not self-evident, see the respective determinants.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B01160">
<head-word>בָּרָאָה, </head-word>
<head-word>בָּרָיָיא, </head-word>
<head-word>בָּרָיָה</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="B01152">בַּר I</xref>
<language-key> ch.)</language-key></definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>external, foreign, not belonging to</italic>, opp. גַּוָּאָה.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Kings XVI, 18; a. e.—Y. Pes. VII, beg. 34
<sup>a</sup> תנא ב', v. בַּר I ch.—Gen. R. s. 49; Yalk. Gen. 83 (interpret. חָלִילָה Gen. XIII, 25) (בריה) ברייה הוא לך it is foreign to thy nature; v. הִיצָה I.—
<plural-form>Pl. בָּרָאֵי</plural-form>. Kidd. 33
<sup>a</sup> בתי ב' the outer chambers of the bath-house. Ḥag. 5
<sup>b</sup> בתי ב' the outer chambers of the heavens. B. Bath. 30
<sup>a</sup> בשוקי ב' in the market places abroad.—Fem. בָּרַיְתָא, בָּרַיְיתָא. Targ. Ezek. XLII, 1; a. e.—Y. M. Kat. III, beg. 81
<sup>c</sup>; Y. Ned. X, 42
<sup>b</sup> top ארעא ב' (= h. חוץ לארץ) abroad; v. אֶרֶץ.—
<plural-form>Pl. בַּרְיָתָא, בַּרְיָיתָא</plural-form>. Targ. Prov. XXX, 4 ב' דארעא the extreme ends of &c.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (as noun) 
<italic>street, open place, field</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 40
<sup>b</sup> sit down בשוקי ובב' Rashi (ed. בשוקא) in markets and open places (i.e. in public). Ḥull. 43; 47
<sup>a</sup>; 58
<sup>b</sup> חיוי ב' the animals of the prairies, v. בַּר I ch.—Esp. בָּרַיְיתָא, בָּרַיְתָא (sub. מתניתא = h. משנה החיצונה) 
<italic>Baraitha</italic> (or 
<italic>Boraitha</italic>), traditions and opinions of Tannaim not embodied in the Mishnah as compiled by R. Judah han-Nasi. [A collection of such Baraithas is found in the Tosefta (תוספתא) which bears the nearest resemblance to the Mishnah and is called by that name in Talm. Y.—The B. in frequently called מתניתא (Ch.) in contrad. to משנה (Hebr.), v. Num. R. s. 18 (ref. to Cant. VI, 8); Lev. R. s. 30.]—Sabb. 19
<sup>b</sup>; Erub. 19
<sup>b</sup>; a. e. ב' לא שמיע' ליה (cmp. Sabb. 61
<sup>a</sup>; Pes. 101
<sup>b</sup> מתנית' לא וכ') he did not know that Boraitha. Ber. 19
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01161">
<head-word>בְּרָאִי</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (v. 
<xref rid="B01160">preced.</xref>) = אַבְרָאִי 
<italic>outside</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ab. Zar. 28
<sup>a</sup> מכה דב' an external wound.—(Adv.) Zeb. 15
<sup>a</sup> דקאי זר ב' the layman stands outside. Ib. לב' נפיק וכ' does (the blood) run only outside (away from the altar) and not also inside (in all directions)?</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01162">
<head-word>בְּרֵאשִׁית</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>in the beginning</italic>, as a cosmological term (ref. to Gen. I, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>creation, primeval period, Nature, Universe</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Is. XXVIII, 29; a. e.—מִבְּ' 
<italic>from the beginning</italic>. Ib. XLI, 4.—מעשה ב' a) 
<italic>creation</italic>. Gen. R. s. 3; a. fr.—b) 
<italic>cosmogony</italic>, contrad. to מעשה מרכבה theosophy, Ḥag. II, 1; a. fr.—Y. Shebi. I, beg. 33
<sup>a</sup> שבת ב' the Sabbath commemorative of creation, i.e. the regular weekly Sabbath, contrad. to Holy Days. <italic>to strengthen, make well, make grow</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. II Sam. III, 35 (Var. לאוֹכָלָא, v. הַבְרָאָה). Succ. 44
<sup>b</sup>; M. Kat. 3
<sup>a</sup> אַבְרוּיֵי אילני to make the trees stronger (facilitate their growth); Ab. Zar. 50
<sup>b</sup> אברויי וכ', opp. אוקומי to preserve the trees. Nidd. 47
<sup>b</sup>; Yeb. 97
<sup>a</sup> אַבְרְיוּהוּ make him grow fat (feed him well). Taan. 21
<sup>b</sup> זיל אַבְרֵי נפשך (ed. בריא, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) go and strengthen thyself.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to permeate, perforate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 112
<sup>a</sup> דאבריה (the blood) soaked through the bread. Ib. 93
<sup>b</sup> דץ ביה מידי דמברי ליה Ar. (ed. only דץ ביה מידי) if he stuck something into it which perforated it (making a passage for the blood).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>

<senses>
<sense>

<notes>. </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be created</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Gen. II, 4; a. fr.—Gen. R. s. 78 מן הן דאתבריין (to) where they were created from. Cant. R. to VIII, 5 וכדון אִתְבְּרִיַית וכ' now thou hast been created again a new creature (having escaped a great danger).—Ber. 54
<sup>b</sup> איברי ליה וכ' a well was created (arose) before him. Snh. 65
<sup>b</sup>; 67
<sup>b</sup> ומִיבְּרִי להו וכ' (not ומיברו, Yalk. Ms. איברי, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) and a three years’ calf was created (arose) before them (Yalk. Ex. 182 ומַבְרֵי they created).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to become strong</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Snh. VIII, 26
<sup>c</sup> מכיון דאִבְּרִי ליביה עלוי וכ' since his heart (passion) became so strong over him as to do this (or דאַבְרֵי Af. he allowed his passion to become so strong &c.).</notes></sense>

<number>—3)</number>

<xref rid="B01152">בַּר I</xref>, בָּרָא) 
<italic>to grow wild</italic>.</definition>

<italic>B’rerah, subsequent selection, retrospective designation</italic>, i.e. the legal effect resulting from an actual selection or disposal of things previously undefined as to their purpose, e.g. a letter of divorce must be written, with special intention, for the persons concerned; now, “if one says to a scribe, ‘Write for me a letter of divorce for one of my wives whom I may choose to divorce’, none of them can be divorced with it” (Gitt. III, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes>, upon which the remark is made (ib. 24
<sup>b</sup>) הא קא משמע לן דאין ב' this rule of the Mishnah implies the adoption of the principle that subsequent disposal does not react on the original status of the letter of divorce, so as to say that this subsequent selection is equal to a defined intention at the time when the deed was to be written. [The question of B’rerah, i.e. whether a subsequent disposal has or has not a retrospective legal effect, is widely spread in the Talmud, referring both to judicial as well as to ritual cases.] Yoma 55
<sup>b</sup> ר' … לית ליה ב' R. Judah rejects the principle of B’rerah; Y. Shek. VI, 50
<sup>b</sup> אי אמרינן ב' וכ' if we adopt the principle of B., let four Zuz (the value of one offering) be taken out of the bag and thrown into the water, and the balance of the money be permitted for use. Ḥull. 14

<entry id="B01292">

<pos> f.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> ברך)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>blessing, bestowal of prosperity, good wishes, choice, plenty</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 5
<sup>a</sup> הואיל … ב' לדגים because on it the blessing was given to the fish (Gen. I, 22, to be fruitful). Y. ib. I, beg. 24
<sup>d</sup> אין כתיב ב' וכ' the blessing (Gen. II, 3) refers not to man but to the day.—Erub. 63
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. תבא עליו ב' blessing rest upon him (he acts rightly). Keth. 103
<sup>a</sup>; B. Bath. 144
<sup>b</sup> בִּרְכַת הבית ברובה the blessing of a house consists in the number of inmates (every member of a household contributes to its comfort); Tosef. Keth. XII, 3 ב' הבית מרובה. B. Mets. 42
<sup>a</sup> אין הב' מצוייה וכ' blessing (unexpected supply, miraculous increase) will not take place in things which are weighed &c.; Taan. 8
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—Pes. 50
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. אינו רואה סימן ב' לעולם will never see a sign of prosperity; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>benediction, prayer to be recited on certain occasions</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 35
<sup>a</sup> man must not taste anything בלא ב' without a blessing. Ib. 40
<sup>b</sup> כל ב' שאין וכ' a benediction in which the Name of the Lord is not invoked, is no benediction; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. בְּרָכוֹת</plural-form>. 1) 
<italic>blessings, benedictions</italic>. Ib. 45
<sup>b</sup>; a. v. fr.—Sabb. 115
<sup>b</sup> כותבי ב' those who write out the formulas of prayer.—2) 
<italic>B’rakhoth</italic>, the first treatise of the Mishnah, Talmud, a. Tosefta.—Compounds: בִּרְכַת אבלים the prayer for consolation inserted in the mourners’ grace after meal. Keth. 8
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.—ב' ארוסין benediction preceding betrothal, v. אֵרוּסִין Ib. 7
<sup>b</sup>.—ב' הארץ that portion of the grace after meal which refers to Palestine. Ib. 8
<sup>b</sup>.—ב' הזבח the benediction before partaking of the festive offering (חֲגִיגָה) which accompanies the Paschal lamb. Pes. X, 9 (120
<sup>a</sup>).—ב' הזימון the appeal to the partakers of a meal to say grace, 
<italic>common prayer</italic>. Ber. 45
<sup>b</sup>.—ב' חתנים benediction on performing the marriage ceremony, also inserted in the grace after wedding meals during seven days. Keth. 8
<sup>b</sup>.—ב' כהנים the priestly benediction (Num. VI, 24—26). Sot. VII, 6.—ב' המזון grace after meal. Keth. l. c.—ב' המצוות benediction on performing a divine command (of a symbolic nature). Ib. 7
<sup>b</sup>.—ב' רחבה benediction of consolation pronounced in open air on the mourners’ return from burial (v. הַבְרָאָה). Ib. 8
<sup>b</sup>.—ב' התורה benediction before and after reading the Law. Y. Ber. I, 3
<sup>c</sup>.—[For other compounds see the respective determinants.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>blasphemy</italic>.</definition>
<notes> בִּרְכַת השם. Snh. 56
<sup>a</sup> sq.; (Tosef. Ab. Zar. VIII (IX), 4 קיללת).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<head-word>בְּרֵיק</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>to shine, rise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Yoma III, beg. 40
<sup>b</sup>; Y. R. Hash. II, beg. 57
<sup>d</sup> what is בורקי (Mish. Yoma III, </notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition />
<notes>? It means בָּרֶקֶת, the rising light, as people say in Babylonia (בְּרַק ברוקא) בְּרוּק ברוקה the sparkling (star) shines, meaning אנהר מנהורא the light-giver (morning star) gives light. [Bab. Yoma 28
<sup>b</sup> (hebr.) בָּרַק ברקאי.] Ber. 59
<sup>a</sup> (expl. רעמים) ברקא תקיפא דבריק בעננא וכ' an intense lightning which flashes through the cloud and breaks pieces of hailstone, (Var. v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.).</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Af.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אַבְרֵיק</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to send forth lightning</italic> (fulminare).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ps. CXLIV, 6.—Targ. II Esth. III, 8 מבריקין עיניהון their eyes sparkling (in defiance). [Ḥull. 112
<sup>a</sup> דאבריק some ed., read דאבריה, v. בְּרָא.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="B01335">
<head-word>בָּרַר</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="unknown"> √בר</xref>,
<xref rid="B00041"> contr. of באר</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> בור)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to clear, clean; to place outside</italic>, whence] </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to make clear, prove, ascertain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Keth. 46
<sup>a</sup> (interpret. Deut. XXII, 17) ובוֹרְרִין את הדבר וכ' and they make the fact as clear (bright) as a new garment.—Part. pass. בָּרוּר q. v.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to single out, select, sift, assort.</italic></definition>
<notes> Maasr. II, 6 שאָבוֹר לי which I may select for me. Ib. בּוֹרֵר ואוכל he has a right to pick out and eat (one after the other). Kil. II, 1 יָבוֹר he must take it out entirely. Sabb. VII, 2 הבּוֹרֵר he who sifts (a labor forbidden on the Sabbath). Y. ib. VII, 10
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. משום בורר (is guilty) because it comes under the class of sifting. Bab. ib. 74
<sup>a</sup> בורר ואוכל וכ' he may take out singly and eat, take out singly and put it down (rejecting it) ולא יִבְרוֹר but he must not assort (v. discussion ibid.). Gitt. V, 9 לא תָבוֹר she must not help her to sift the grain. Snh. 45
<sup>a</sup> בְּרוֹר לו וכ' choose for the convict the most gentle method of execution; Sot. 8
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr.—Snh. III, 1 זה בורר וכ' each party chooses one judge, and the two judges בּוֹרְרִין וכ' elect a third.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בֵּרַר, בֵּירַר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to prove, ascertain</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 23
<sup>b</sup> צריך לבָרֵר the claimant must offer clear evidence. Kerith. 24
<sup>a</sup> לב' עוון to ascertain whether or not the woman was guilty; Num. R. s. 9, v. בָּעַר. Y. Kidd. III, 63
<sup>d</sup>, v. סִימְפּוֹן. Lev. R. s. 11; v. 
<italic>Nithpa.</italic></notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to sift, select</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>c</sup> top דש זרה ובי' he threshed, winnowed and sifted. Y. Ned. I, beg. 51
<sup>a</sup> לשונות שביררו להן וכ' the terms (for oaths, vows &c.) which the Mishnahs have selected (as substitutes for the real expressions of oaths &c.); Bab. ib. 10
<sup>b</sup> שבדו, v. בָּדָא. [Esth. R. to I, 22 [read:] בירר להם בלשון … רומי מלשון יוני interpreted for them (the Bible) in Latin &c., v. בָּדָא. The passage is defective; cmp. Y. Meg. I, 71
<sup>c</sup> top.] [Y. Snh. X, 28
<sup>a</sup> בחרו להם ביררו הברזל וכ', read בְּרִיּוּת, they selected (as similes for the Law) the soundness of the iron and the fixedness of the tree; cmp. Num. R. s. 14; Koh. R. to XII, 11.]</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hof.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הוּבְרָר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be cleared up, to be decided</italic> (between two alternatives); v. 
<xref rid="B01275">בְּרֵירָה</xref>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. 4
<sup>a</sup> (a hen is bought either for consumption or for breeding) נשחטה הובְרָרָה וכ' by its being killed, it appears that it was originally intended for slaughtering; Ḥull. 14
<sup>a</sup></notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִבְרָר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be selected</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. Sh’laḥ. 4 נִבְרְרוּ צדיקים they were righteous at the time they were selected.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִתְבָּרֵר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to desire clearness, to seek evidence, search for truth</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 11 (ref. to II Sam. XXII, 26 sq.) בשעה שנ' על עסקיו הק"בה בירר לו וכ' when he desired to be enlightened about his affairs (asking, ‘Whereby shall I know, Gen. XV, 8), the Lord enlightened him &c. (ib. 13). Ib. בשעה שנ' וכ' (with ref. to Moses); Midr. Till. to Ps. XVIII, 26 sq.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be confirmed, established</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. 
<pgbrk id="pg198" />T’tsavveh 9, end [read:] נִתְבָּרְרָה כהונה בידם through them the priesthood became established. Pesik. Dibré p. 115
<sup>b</sup> [read as:] Yalk. Jer. 258 לא נ' … עד שעמד וכ' their prophecies were not fulfilled until Jer. arose.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
